description.value: The study investigated caregiver burden in corticobasal syndrome and frontal-variant frontotemporal dementia and used voxel-based morphometry to identify gray-matter atrophy associated with caregiver burden.

spans.text: We wanted to replicate the correlations between caregiver burden and neuropsychological and demographic variables found in previous studies on FTD and CBS patients, and in addition, use voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to find neural correlates of atrophy that predict higher levels of burden in the primary caregivers.

model_settings.value: SPM5 unified segmentation with default options; gray-matter images were modulated, normalized, and smoothed with a 12-mm FWHM filter. Group comparisons included age, gender, scanner manufacturer, and total intracranial volume as covariates; whole-brain FWE correction at p=0.05 with an extent threshold of 30 voxels. Anatomical localization used MEDx.

source_definition.value: Total caregiver burden measured by the 22-item Zarit Burden Interview, scored from 0 to 88.

model_settings.value: Within each patient group, gray-matter density was correlated with total caregiver burden using negative one-sided t tests, with positive one-sided t tests as a quality-control check. Age, gender, total intracranial volume, and scanner manufacturer were covariates. Analyses were restricted to the explicit mask of significant patient-control gray-matter differences; voxel threshold p<0.001 uncorrected and extent threshold 30 voxels.
